title: Wayfarer’s Oath: The Last Lantern
summary: A twelve-chapter level20–50 story, five oath paths and a complete earned armor outfit.
body:
Mera Vell has three entrance reports and the same name scratched out of every one. Captain Selene’s company entered the dark together; somebody sold their names to come back alone. Carry the lantern, bring the missing voices home, and decide how they will be remembered.

Begin in East Commonlands

At level20, hail the Ancient Chronicler in the tunnel, near /loc -1585, -215, 4, and choose the Adventure Journal. Your normal Tasks window tracks the chapters. The story continues through the current level50 endgame. Complete the three opening chapters, earn one oath path, then follow eight further chapters.

Fully exit EverQuest and press Play in the launcher for signed update2026110701 before starting. Mera Vell, Oren Lanternwright and Tovin stand nearby. Oren handles earned equipment; the Chronicler offers chapters, oath attunement and journal expeditions.

The journey

These are minimum levels. Prepare gear, trained skills, recovery and legal AAs for the later encounters; reaching the level alone does not finish the story.

Choose your oath

Any class combination can earn an oath. One completed path opens the rest of the campaign. Further paths are optional: they add attunement choices to the same charm, with one shared ten-minute recovery.

Guardian: The Unbroken Oath

Defeat the froglok shin lord; Defeat Lord Pickclaw; Final trial: defeat Xicotl. Return to the Chronicler and claim or attune your oath.

Oathguard: Absorb 15% of melee damage, up to 200 damage total, for at most 3 ticks.

Striker: A Decisive Hand

Defeat Butler Syncall; Defeat Maid Issis; Final trial: defeat Garton Viswin. Return to the Chronicler and claim or attune your oath.

Decisive Hand: Gain a 6% melee damage modifier for at most 3 ticks; normal stacking rules apply.

Arcanist: The Measured Flame

Defeat Battlewizard Unak; Defeat High Priest Zaharn; Final trial: defeat Lasna Cheroon. Return to the Chronicler and claim or attune your oath.

Measured Flame: Gain a 5% spell damage focus for direct damage and DoTs for at most 3 ticks; normal stacking rules apply.

Warden: The Last Light

Defeat Khrix Fritchoff; Defeat Maid Issis; Final trial: defeat Garanel Rucksif. Return to the Chronicler and claim or attune your oath.

Last Light: Instantly restore 10% of your maximum HP, capped at 400 base healing before normal healing bonuses.

Binder: An Unbroken Bond

Defeat King Thex'Ka IV; Defeat Mynthi Davissi; Final trial: defeat Xicotl. Return to the Chronicler and claim or attune your oath.

Unbroken Bond: One targeted owned pet gains an 8% melee damage modifier and 10% melee absorption (150 damage cap), for at most 3 ticks.

Private company memories

The Chronicler opens separate, hour-long journal expeditions for the Unrest rescue and later field chapters. These reconstruct the company’s past; Tovin’s presence in Commonlands is part of the story. They do not replace public zones or Keeper Raid/Grind runs. Solo characters and groups of up to six can enter; SSF characters enter alone.

Hail each remembered voice and choose its response. Stay with an escort, lead it to the displayed checkpoints, draw pursuers away and heal the companion when needed. Three waves must be survived in order. Dead, distant or disconnected characters receive no credit; combat credit also follows the killer’s current native party, including owned pet and swarm attribution. A helper needs their own active chapter and prerequisites to advance. Late helpers may replay earlier checkpoints.

If a defense fails, speak with the company to try the memory again. Hail the lanternlit wayfarer to return to Commonlands. These actors grant no repeatable XP or loot. Durable Tasks retain completed checkpoints; no reward is earned by merely entering a scene.

The Hollow Witness

The finale has three parts: answer the bindings, defend the company standard through three waves, then confront its recorder. When the Witness marks your feet, move at least ten units within three seconds or stun him before the brand resolves. Watch the shout and yellow message. Return to the Commonlands campfire after the victory to finish the chapter, earn the final armor step and unlock the Lanternbearer title.

An outfit earned along the road

Earn boots, gloves, two bracers, arms, legs, head and chest. These are useful progression items with a coordinated slate-and-blue look. Oren offers woven, leather, chain or plate pieces when one of your held classes permits that fit. The woven chest uses an existing robe appearance. Your race and client models determine the rendered result; full appearance checks remain in live testing.

Return to Oren after the level40 furnace chapter, level46 Fear chapter and final level50 campfire for the Oathbound, Restored and Complete refits. Refitting an earned piece preserves augments, custom dye, binding and ornaments. Finish the chapter first: a new level alone does not unlock its refit. Choose the armor fit and refit each eligible piece through Oren’s links; this does not automatically equip an outfit.

Campaign equipment is personal, cannot be traded, transferred to another character, given to pets or sold for coin. A missing receipted item is not replaced for free; recover it from your bank or corpse before refitting. Do not destroy a piece to change its fit. The six major armor pieces have a type22 augment socket; bracers do not. No armor set bonus, haste, focus, heroic stats or stacked oath clicks are added. Harder endgame loot retains its progression role.

Live testing

The campaign is installed for live QA. Native checks and measured earned-gear combat runs do not complete player acceptance of all paths, escort behavior, race/gender armor rendering or the full finale. Report the chapter, zone, party, class combination and what happened if progress stalls.
